solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Unruly argument in open discussion meetings with Liberal left

parts.note: free means open, as in free to all
fora is the Latin plural of forum, a meeting for discussion

explanation.surface: A rowdy row breaks out at public debates once a Liberal politician has walked out.
explanation.definitionFit: A free-for-all is a chaotic dispute or fight in which anyone may join, so an unruly argument.

clue.text: Fanatical attack captures bishop

indicators.note: to capture something is to hold it within, so one piece goes inside the other

parts.note: a raid is a sudden attack
B is the chess abbreviation for bishop

explanation.surface: A frenzied assault ends in a churchman being taken prisoner.
explanation.definitionFit: Rabid describes someone extreme or zealous in their views, the same as fanatical.

clue.text: Australian bird, a sort of teal, is mimic

parts.note: the emu is a large flightless Australian bird

indicators.note: a sort of teal suggests a variant form of the word, so its letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: An odd claim that an emu, or some kind of duck, is a copycat.
explanation.definitionFit: To emulate someone is to copy or imitate them, so it is a verb synonym of mimic.

clue.text: Not at home in Tynemouth

indicators.note: the answer lies in the letters of the place name, tucked within it

explanation.surface: Someone reports that they were away from home while visiting a town in north-east England.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone who is out has gone away from their house, so is not at home.

clue.text: Important transport link cut by hostile heavy guns

indicators.note: a word cut by another is split open with that other placed in the gap

parts.note: an artery is a major road or rail route
ill can mean unfriendly or hostile, as in ill will

explanation.surface: A key supply route has been severed by enemy big guns.
explanation.definitionFit: Artillery is the collective name for large-calibre guns used in land warfare.

clue.text: The French half murder Madagascan native

parts.note: le is the French masculine word for the

indicators.note: half of a six-letter word means its first three letters are kept

explanation.surface: French killers dispatch half of some creature from Madagascar.
explanation.definitionFit: Lemurs are primates found in the wild only on the island of Madagascar.

clue.text: Gamekeeper's beginning to stir up birds

indicators.note: the beginning of the word is its opening letter

parts.note: to rouse is to stir up or disturb

explanation.surface: A gamekeeper starts out by flushing game from cover.
explanation.definitionFit: Grouse are game birds; the word serves as its own plural, so it can mean several birds.

clue.text: Kidnap a French duke in outskirts of Brest

indicators.note: one piece is placed in another, sitting inside it
the outskirts of a word are its first and last letters

parts.note: duc is the French word for duke

explanation.surface: A French nobleman is seized on the edge of the Breton port of Brest.
explanation.definitionFit: To abduct someone is to carry them off by force, a synonym of kidnap.

clue.text: Sound quality of Britain reduced in time

indicators.note: one piece is placed in another, sitting inside it

parts.note: taken as the word time itself
Britain is reduced to its short form BR, a standard abbreviation

explanation.surface: Something about how Britain sounds diminished over the years.
explanation.definitionFit: Timbre is the tonal character of a voice or instrument, distinct from its pitch or loudness.

clue.text: One mostly loved thought

parts.note: I is the Roman numeral one

indicators.note: mostly means all but the last letter is used

parts.note: dear means loved or cherished

explanation.surface: Someone thinks they were largely adored.
explanation.definitionFit: An idea is a notion or something thought of, so a noun synonym of thought.

clue.text: Tanning facility located centrally in resort island, luring frumps?

indicators.note: each of the four words gives up the two letters at its centre

explanation.surface: A tanning salon at a holiday island is drawing in dowdy visitors.
explanation.definitionFit: A solarium is a room or salon fitted with sunlamps or sunbeds for getting a tan.

clue.text: Eastern US is mad for sweet wine

indicators.note: letters that are mad are crazed and disordered, so they are rearranged

explanation.surface: The eastern United States has gone crazy for a dessert wine.
explanation.definitionFit: Sauternes is a sweet white dessert wine from the Bordeaux region of France.

clue.text: Dandy around university runs business department

indicators.note: the first piece goes around the others, enclosing them

parts.note: a beau is a fashionable dandy
R is the cricket abbreviation for runs

explanation.surface: A fop on campus is running a corporate office.
explanation.definitionFit: A bureau is an office or agency, a division handling one area of business.

clue.text: Loud PA broadcast put on a bigger system

indicators.note: broadcast seed is scattered widely, so the letters are scattered and rearranged

explanation.surface: A loudspeaker announcement is played over a larger sound system.
explanation.definitionFit: To upload is to transfer data from a local device to a larger computer system or server.

clue.text: Better, except when editor's replacing short part

indicators.note: one piece takes the place of another inside the word

parts.note: taken as the word except itself
PT is the short form of part
ED is the abbreviation for editor

explanation.surface: An editor improves a text, apart from swapping in a brief section.
explanation.definitionFit: To better something is to go beyond or surpass it, the same verb sense as exceed.

clue.text: Source of starch fool put in Spanish fizz

indicators.note: one piece is put in another, sitting inside it

parts.note: cava is Spanish sparkling wine
an ass is a fool

explanation.surface: A recipe step: a fruit fool, starch and Spanish sparkling wine are combined.
explanation.definitionFit: Cassava is a tropical root crop whose tubers yield starch, the source of tapioca.

clue.text: Brilliant group of puppies following good year

indicators.note: one piece comes after another in the answer

parts.note: a litter is a set of young born together

explanation.surface: A dazzling batch of puppies arrives after a fine year for breeding.
explanation.definitionFit: Glittery means sparkling and shining, one sense of brilliant.

clue.text: Short time in drag for cast

indicators.note: one piece sits in another, enclosed by it

parts.note: to tow is to drag along
HR is the short form of hour, a time

explanation.surface: A brief spell in women's clothing for the actors in a show.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Cast' looks like the actors of a drag show, but it is the verb meaning to hurl.
explanation.definitionFit: To throw is to hurl or fling, the same as one sense of cast.

clue.text: Noticed small cuts

parts.note: saw means noticed

explanation.surface: Someone spotted some minor reductions.
explanation.definitionFit: Saws as a verb means cuts with a toothed blade.

clue.text: Sea creature in western sound

parts.note: hale means sound or healthy, as in hale and hearty

explanation.surface: A marine animal is heard off the west coast.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Sound' suggests a noise or a stretch of water, but it means healthy.
explanation.definitionFit: A whale is a very large marine mammal, an example of a sea creature.

clue.text: Unproductive noble, by the sound of it

indicators.note: the answer is spoken the same as a word for the noble, though spelt otherwise

parts.note: a baron is a nobleman

explanation.surface: A lazy aristocrat, or so people say.
explanation.definitionFit: Barren land or effort yields nothing, so it is unproductive.

clue.text: Medicine man with counterfeit article

parts.note: a sham is a fake, something counterfeit
an is the indefinite article

explanation.surface: A quack doctor peddles fake goods.
explanation.definitionFit: A shaman is a tribal healer or priest, often called a medicine man.

clue.text: View scene regularly omitted

indicators.note: every other letter is dropped, leaving the first, third and fifth

explanation.surface: A view of a scene keeps getting left out.
explanation.definitionFit: To see something is to view it, so the verbs are synonyms.

clue.text: Some rubbish appears wet for recycling

indicators.note: recycled material is broken down and remade, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Damp-looking litter is put out for the recycling bin.
explanation.definitionFit: Wastepaper is discarded paper, one kind of rubbish.
